data.name: Healing Aura Rune
data.description: A stone tablet that radiates soothing green energy. When activated, it creates a restorative field that gradually heals all allies within its radius.

effects.description: Every 2 played turns, they heal all allies for 10% of their maximum HP. This effect does not heal the caster.

data.name: Protection Rune
data.description: A simple stone tablet etched with protective symbols. When activated, it creates a translucent magical shell that absorbs incoming damage.

effects.description: When they drop below 40% of their HP, they gain 40 % resistance to all elements for 3 turns. Activates once per combat. This effect is only active during boss or raid boss fights.

data.name: Healing Rune
data.description: A stone tablet etched with ancient symbols of restoration. When activated, it emits a warm green glow that mends wounds and restores vitality.

effects.description: Every 3 played turns, restores 5% of HP at the start of the turn.

data.name: Burn Rune
data.description: A smoldering rune that applies lingering damage to enemies. The flames are impossible to extinguish by normal means.

effects.description: On his first turn, apply a burn effect of 20% of your attack of all elements. The damage is applied each turn and decreases by 10% each time.

data.name: Lifesteal Rune
data.description: A blood-red rune that, when activated, allows its wielder to draw life from their critical strikes.

effects.description: Restores 15% of the total attack of all elements in HP after a critical strike.

data.name: Vampiric Rune
data.description: A dark crimson rune that seems to drink in surrounding light. It infuses attacks with blood magic that drains life from enemies while fueling a battle rage.

effects.description: After landing a critical hit, they heal the ally with the lowest HP for 30% of the damage dealt. Can only trigger once every 3 turns. This effect does not heal the caster.
Each time they land a critical hit, they give 15% damage to themselves and their allies until the end of their next turn.

data.name: Greater Lifesteal Rune
data.description: A blood-red rune that pulses with dark hunger. It channels life essence from critical strikes to the bearer while feeding a growing battle frenzy.

effects.description: Restores 25% of the total attack of all elements in HP after a critical strike.
Each time they land a critical hit, they give 15% damage to themselves and their allies until the end of their next turn.

data.name: Greater Protection Rune
data.description: A blue-hued stone tablet inscribed with layered defensive sigils. When activated, it creates overlapping shields that absorb physical and magical damage alike.

effects.description: If one or more allies have less than 50% of their HP, protects the ally with the lowest HP percentage, redirecting 50 % of their damage to this character until the start of my next turn. Activates a maximum of 3 times per combat.
When they drop below 40% of their HP, they gain 35 % resistance to all elements for 3 turns. Activates once per combat. This effect is only active during boss or raid boss fights.

data.name: Greater Healing Rune
data.description: An advanced healing rune that pulses with powerful regenerative magic. Its soothing aura continuously rejuvenates allies while healing the bearer directly.

effects.description: Every 2 played turns, they heal all allies for 12% of their maximum HP. This effect does not heal the caster.
Every 3 played turns, restores 8% of HP at the start of the turn.

data.name: Enchanted Rune
data.description: A rune carved with forest magic, strengthening mirrored enchantments and restorative power.

effects.description: When the fighter takes damage, they deal back 50% of the damage taken. This can trigger once every 3 turns.
Every 3 played turns, restores 5% of HP at the start of the turn.

data.name: Powerful Rune
data.description: A forceful rune humming with concentrated power, sharpening greed and frenzy in equal measure.

effects.description: Each time the fighter loses 10% max HP, they gain 15% damage for the rest of the fight.
Each time they land a critical hit, they give 12% damage to themselves and their allies until the end of their next turn.
